tokens: "You are a young adventurer on a mission to find the legendary treasure hidden deep in the forest.\n"
"Your goal is to navigate through four rooms, each with its own unique challenges and obstacles.\n"
"\nYou find yourself at the entrance of the forest. There are four paths in front of you.\n"
"\nYou have chosen the Path of the Mage. Good choice!\n"
"\nYou have chosen the Path of the Warrior. Fight well!\n"
"\nYou have chosen the Path of the Rogue. Sneaky choice!\n"
"\nYou have chosen the Path of the Monk. Peaceful choice!\n"
"\nYou enter the first room, and see a chest in the center of the room.\n"
"\nThe chest is locked. You need to find a key.\n"
"You notice a key-shaped hole in the wall.\n"
"\nYou find a loose brick in the wall, and a key falls out.\n"
"You grab the key, and use it to open the chest.\n"
"Inside the chest, you find a map to the next room!\n"
"\nYou decide not to approach the wall, and look around the room.\n"
"After searching for a while, you find a key under a loose floorboard.\n"
"You use the key to open the chest, and find a map to the next room!\n"
"\nYou decide not to open the chest, and look around the room.\n"
"After searching for a while, you find a map to the next room!\n"
"\nYou enter the second room, and see a puzzle on the wall.\n"
"There are six symbols on the wall, and six buttons beneath them.\n"
"\nYou press the correct symbol, and the puzzle unlocks!\n"
"You find a map to the next room!\n"
"\nYou press the wrong symbol, and the puzzle shakes.\n"
"You hear a rumble, and see a boulder falling toward you!\n"
"2. Try to push the boulder out of the way.\n"
"3. Let the boulder hit you, and hope for the best.\n"
"\nYou try to dodge the boulder, but it hits you!\n"
"\nYou try to push the boulder out of the way, but it's too heavy!\n"
"\nYou let the boulder hit you, and somehow survive!\n"
"You crawl out from under the boulder, and find a map to the next room!\n"
"\nYou enter the third room, and see a monster blocking your path!\n"
"The monster looks dangerous. What do you do?\n"
"2. Try to sneak past the monster.\n"
"\nYou defeated the monster, and find a key to the next room!\n"
"\nYou try to sneak past the monster.\n"
"\nYou successfully sneak past the monster, and find a key to the next room!\n"
"\nThe monster spots you, and attacks you!\n"
"\nYou defeated the monster, and find a key to the next room!\n"
"\nYou try to bribe the monster with gold.\n"
"\nThe monster accepts your bribe, and lets you pass!\n"
"You find a key to the next room!\n"
"\nThe monster doesn't accept your bribe, and attacks you!\n"
"\nYou defeated the monster, and find a key to the next room!\n"
"\nYou enter the fourth and final room.\n"
"You see the treasure chest in front of you, but also a guardian dragon!\n"
"2. Try to sneak past the dragon.\n"
"3. Use a special spell to freeze the dragon.\n"
"\nYou defeated the dragon, and unlocked the treasure chest!\n"
"\nYou try to sneak past the dragon.\n"
"\nYou successfully sneak past the dragon, and unlock the treasure chest!\n"
"\nThe dragon spots you, and attacks you!\n"
"\nYou defeated the dragon, and unlocked the treasure chest!\n"
"\nYou use a special spell to freeze the dragon!\n"
"\nYou successfully freeze the dragon, and unlock the treasure chest!\n"
"\nThe dragon breaks free of the ice, and attacks you!\n"
"\nYou defeated the dragon, and unlocked the treasure chest!\n"
"\nCongratulations, you have completed the Text-Based Adventure Game!\n"
"You have found the legendary treasure, and are considered a hero in the land!\n"
